quality.review_scope: All preparation branches, explicitly reported controls, workup and specimen preparation in the local main article and SI; source-linked structure and optical observations with missingness and conflicts. No complete-paper Reader or measured atomic model.
missing_fields: No measured atomic coordinates or complete source unit cell.
Source context IDs do not assert a separately identifiable physical batch.
Chalcogen-stock dissolution details, nitrogen flow, injection duration and generic centrifugation speed/time unreported.
Workup solvent amounts, isolated yield and final concentration unreported.
Alternative sample options are not combined in one vessel. Shared settings come from the source-stated typical framework; explicit variant values override them.
conflicts: SI size-tuning series explicitly uses Cd:SA 4:1; the typical preparation and separate TOP-ratio controls use 8:1. These are separate source branches.
